D_officer_counterfactual.grouping: test searches (2016-2018) in fifths of the officer's past consent hit rate, known before the search
D_officer_counterfactual.assumption: illustrative: the bottom group keeps its finds and drops searches until it reaches the median group hit rate; bootstrap over officers

G_first_stop_check.scope: consent searches 2011-2018 (2010 = warm-up); first = no earlier stop by this officer on the same calendar day

caveats: Selective labels: only searches that were made are observed.
Economics treat each search as independent and ignore deterrence and the value of the contraband; the break-even hit rate is an assumption, shown over a range.
Calibration: all models were trained on 2010-2015 (16.1% hit rate) and tested on 2016-2018 (21.4%), so every group is under-predicted; compare groups, not levels.
Officer IDs are hashed; results are reported for groups of officers only.
